text:
Riley: Heads-up team — Zephyr Health POC kickoff rescheduled to Thu 9:30am PT. We need to lock the POC success criteria and make sure security + pricing questions are prepped. Quick sync thread to finalize before the call.

Nora: Key use cases they care about: 1) clinical note search + rerank, 2) structured extraction of meds/conditions, 3) concise patient-summary generation for care teams. They want the POC to show latency under load (200rps) and an end-to-end demo with anonymized notes.

Diego: Technical constraints: their notes avg 1.2k tokens, but some go up to 6k. We should plan for context window handling (prefixing + chunk + rerank). For embeddings we should use 1536-d and cosine similarity unless they insist on dot product. They will likely call embeddings in near-real-time for search.

Kumar_InfoSec: From the security side: they require a completed questionnaire, support for CMEK if private, and an isolated log-retention policy. Also want to know if training/update ops can be disabled (they do not want customer data used for model updates).

Priya: Success criteria request from their PM: 1) Retrieval precision@10 >= 0.78, 2) MED concept extraction F1 >= 0.82, 3) Patient-summary acceptability >= 88% in blinded clinician evals. They also want the final deck to include latency and cost per 1k requests.

Avery_SE: Notes on evals: We'll run a 500-prompt eval set: 300 search queries, 100 structured extraction cases, 100 summarization prompts. Proposed metrics: Precision@10, concept F1, ROUGE-L / human acceptability. Also propose a smoke test for tail latencies (95th %ile <450ms).

Riley: Pricing: let's offer 4-week POC credits covering estimated token throughput + a small engineering support retainer. Nora, can you estimate token volumes based on their note sizes and 200rps peak?

Nora: Quick calc: if average call sends 1.2k tokens and we expect 200rps peak but avg 50rps during POC, over 4 weeks (~2.4M seconds) that's a lot — but POC expected traffic will be limited. For safety propose 1M tokens credits and explain overage pricing.

Diego: For the inference plan: we should test rdx-v2 (quantized 8bit) vs rdx-large-fp16 for QA route. Use KV cache + prefix caching for repeated contexts. Will need Dedicated GPU pool if we want stable 200rps.

Kumar_InfoSec: Also: ask customer about their network requirements — do they need VPC peering, private endpoints, or will HTTPS suffice? If private, confirm IP ranges.

InfraBot: Reminder: Dedicated GPU pool request ETA is 48-72h. File request with tag `zephyr-health-poc`.

Riley: Action items: Avery 94 prepare eval harness + runner commands (due EOD), Nora 94 finalize sample token estimate and POC credit proposal (due EOD), Kumar 94 send security questionnaire + CMEK options, Diego 94 stub inference config and GPU pool request if needed, Priya 94 confirm clinical stakeholders for blinded evals. We'll reconvene 30m before kickoff.

Priya: I'll invite the three clinician reviewers and request anonymized sample set. Also flagging that compliance will need the DPA/DLAs signed before moving to Dedicated.

Riley: Thanks all. Keep remarks in thread if anything else comes up. :white_check_mark:
